surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 46 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah An-Naazi'aat (Those who drag forth) is the 79th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 46 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَالنَّازِعَاتِ غَرْقًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والنازعات غرقا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: By those [angels] who extract with violence
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By the forceful chargers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] those who remove with ease
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: raring to go

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: sweeping ahead at full stretch

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And those who race each other in a race
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: overtaking swiftly

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And those who arrange [each] matter
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: to bring the matter to an end

ayahs.translation_saheeh: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: on the Day when the blast reverberates

ayahs.translation_saheeh: There will follow it the subsequent [one]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the second blast follows

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Hearts, that Day, will tremble
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: hearts will tremble

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Their eyes humbled
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and eyes will be downcast

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They say, ‘What? shall we be brought back to life

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Even if we should be decayed bones
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: after we have turned into decayed bones?’ and they say

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالُواْ تِلۡكَ إِذࣰ ا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةࣱ‏
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Such a return is impossible!’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, it will be but one shout
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But all it will take is a single blast

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and they will be back above ground

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Has there reached you the story of Moses
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Have you [Prophet] heard the story of Moses

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذۡ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذْ نَادَاهُ رَبُّهُ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذ ناداه ربه بالواد المقدس طوى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: His Lord called out to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Go to Pharaoh, for he has exceeded all bounds

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَقُلۡ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَقُلْ هَلْ لَكَ إِلَىٰ أَنْ تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فقل هل لك الى ان تزكى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and ask him, “Do you want to purify yourself [of sin]

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do you want me to guide you to your Lord, so that you may hold Him in awe?” ’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he showed him the greatest sign
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Moses showed him the great sign

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but he denied it and refused [the faith]

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then he turned his back, striving
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He turned away and hastily

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he gathered [his people] and called out
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: gathered his people, proclaiming

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And said, "I am your most exalted lord
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘I am your supreme lord,’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so God condemned him to punishment in the life to come as well as in this life

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةࣰ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰٓ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِمَنْ يَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان في ذلك لعبرة لمن يخشى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: there truly is a lesson in this for anyone who stands in awe of God

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَأَنْتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ السَّمَاءُ ۚ بَنَاهَا
ayahs.arabic_clean: اانتم اشد خلقا ام السماء ۚ بناها
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Which is harder to create: you people or the sky that He built

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: raising it high and perfecting it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: giving darkness to its night and bringing out its morning brightness

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And after that He spread the earth
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the earth, too, He spread out

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He extracted from it its water and its pasture
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: bringing waters and pastures out of it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the mountains He set firmly
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and setting firm mountains [in it]

ayahs.translation_saheeh: As provision for you and your grazing livestock
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: for you and your animals to enjoy

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When the great overwhelming event arrives

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: on the Day that man remembers what he has done

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and Hell is there for all to see

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So as for he who transgressed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: for anyone who has transgressed

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And preferred the life of the world
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and preferred the present life

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Hell will be home

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفۡسَ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى النَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واما من خاف مقام ربه ونهى النفس عن الهوى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: for anyone who feared the meeting with his Lord and restrained himself from base desires

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Paradise will be home

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They ask you [Prophet] about the Hour

ayahs.translation_saheeh: In what [position] are you that you should mention it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: saying, ‘When will it arrive?’, but how can you tell [them that]

ayahs.translation_saheeh: To your Lord is its finality
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Its time is known only to your Lord

ayahs.translation_saheeh: You are only a warner for those who fear it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you are only sent to warn those who fear it

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوۡ ضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَاهَا
ayahs.arabic_clean: كانهم يوم يرونها لم يلبثوا الا عشية او ضحاها
ayahs.translation_saheeh: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On the Day they see it, it will seem they lingered [in this life] an evening [at most,] or its morning
